ticket.subject: Bulk import of contacts
ticket.body_text:
Dear Support Team,

Writing on behalf of Kettlewick Ltd. What is the best way to import our existing contact list of roughly 3,100 rows?

Our team starts using the app properly once the data is in. The file has name, company and city columns. Here is a screen recording of the problem: https://files.example.net/d/4471?sig=a81f0c&exp=1790000000 Please copy my colleague at kai.nakamura@tidewell.example.com on your reply.

A reply in the next few days would be great. Is there a template file?

Best regards,
Hanna Rasmussen

label_notes: pii howto (howto-bulk-import): a how-to that blocks the start of work is P3; urgency medium: action needed this week; planted: url, email, name.
